# Newsletter writing

**Write an issue people open and finish: one job, a real subject line, social repurposed with care, clean links and honest labels.**

Writes a creator newsletter issue from start to send — one job per issue, subject line and preheader, a scannable structure (opener, main piece, short items, one call to action, sign-off, footer), repurposing the week's social posts into something worth opening, the AI disclosure line, sponsor and affiliate labels, "not financial advice" for coin mentions, link hygiene with UTM tags, the CAN-SPAM footer and a test-send checklist — with a fill-in issue template and a subject-line bank. Use when drafting a newsletter, email digest, weekly recap, launch email or sponsored issue for a creator, an AI character or an agent, on Substack, beehiiv, Kit, Ghost or any email tool, or when turning posts into an email.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | beginner | 60–90 min per issue | `@useclaudia/social` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Give the issue one job
2. Mine the week, don't paste it
3. Outline on the template
4. Write the subject line and preheader
5. Write the body in the voice
6. Clean every link
7. Add the labels
8. Test-send, then a person approves
9. Teaser out, numbers in

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.
